title: Pet Fee Nights Left Out for Notice, by Cancellation Policy
content:
# Pet fee — nights left out for notice

**Rule.** When a guest cancels a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category that recorded a pet fee, the pet-fee refund leaves some of the nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date out for notice. How many nights the pet-fee refund leaves out for notice depends on the stay: a stay of 28 nights or more leaves out the after-check-in notice nights of its cancellation policy; a shorter stay booked under a policy whose after-check-in refund percentage is 0 leaves out none; any other stay leaves out 1.

The stay's nights and its policy are those recorded on the stay.

## By policy

- **Flexible** — after-check-in refund percentage 100.00%; a stay under 28 nights leaves out 1; a stay of 28 nights or more leaves out 1.
- **Moderate** — after-check-in refund percentage 50.00%; a stay under 28 nights leaves out 1; a stay of 28 nights or more leaves out 1.
- **Limited** — after-check-in refund percentage 0.00%; a stay under 28 nights leaves out 0; a stay of 28 nights or more leaves out 0.
- **Firm** — after-check-in refund percentage 0.00%; a stay under 28 nights leaves out 0; a stay of 28 nights or more leaves out 0.
- **Strict** — after-check-in refund percentage 0.00%; a stay under 28 nights leaves out 0; a stay of 28 nights or more leaves out 0.
- **Super Strict 30 Days** — after-check-in refund percentage 0.00%; a stay under 28 nights leaves out 0; a stay of 28 nights or more leaves out 0.
- **Super Strict 60 Days** — after-check-in refund percentage 0.00%; a stay under 28 nights leaves out 0; a stay of 28 nights or more leaves out 0.
- **Long-Term** — after-check-in refund percentage 100.00%; a stay under 28 nights leaves out 1; a stay of 28 nights or more leaves out 30.

## The 28-night line (hypothetical stays)

- A 28-night Long-Term stay leaves out 30 nights; with fewer nights after the cancellation date than that, none of them remains to count.
- A 27-night Moderate stay leaves out 1 night (shorter stay, percentage 50.00%, not 0).
- A 27-night Super Strict 30 Days stay leaves out none (shorter stay, percentage 0).

## Worked count (hypothetical)

A 12-night Flexible stay is cancelled on its fifth night: 7 nights are dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date; 1 is left out for notice, so 6 count toward the pet fee.
